title: Arena-Lite: Efficient and Reliable Large Language Model Evaluation via Tournament-Based Direct Comparisons

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking and visualizing the frequency of an LLM judge selecting a response based purely on its presented order (Position A vs. Position B), and mitigating it by alternating the order of model responses during evaluation.
Plotting and analyzing the win/loss ratio of evaluated models against the length of their generated responses to identify if the LLM judge disproportionately favors longer text.
